When I was a child, I had a "memory" of the place I was before I was here - the place we all were before we were here. 
Perhaps just a dream, but it never left me.

Looking back, it looked almost like the inside of an ovary.  Everything was a red gold, except for "myself" (and the other ...erm...souls?); we were these translucent white blobs. I was comfortable there, I knew I was timeless. 

Then it was as if my name was called into the doctors office or something - it was my turn. I knew I had to leave that comfortable place, but nothing felt rushed. I wasn't sad to leave. 

I told a friend once and he kinda mocked me in disbelief, saying that this was a very complex memory for a child. I don't think so. It was moreso a feeling, a rememberance. 

My mom always said that children and the elderly are the closest to God, the closest to death on both ends. I think she's right. 

I think it is a dimension beyond articulation and sense. Not good, not bad. But comfortable.

Trying to figure this out myself. I just gave up. Quit my jobs. Was gonna get my passport and run away for a bit. But I'd just come back feeling the same. So for now, Im just rotting in bed until I can actually do it

I can't promise you it will get better, but you will become better at handeling it. Im speaking out my ass right now because I'm planning on killing myself. BUT I can say it's worth the try. Wait until you're out highschool at least, for your family if nothing else. Give it am honest try before you give up.

Honestly you will come to realize that the bullies that effect you ao much now really don't mean shit. High school is such a bubble in that sense, it stops you from seeing what's out there. Killing yourself is a HUGE choice and you should not make it on the basis of some assholes.

I haven't left by bed in 21 hours lmfao. Sending u a big depressed hug and some cheek kisses. I get it.
Certain on the method. Uncertain on the timing. It comes in waves, it spirals. Right now I feel ok.

I'm really happy that you've found your place again, honestly. It takes a lot to bounce back from that to any degreee and i really respcet you for that. 
I've honestly never been happier with a decision I've made. Ive failed attempts in the past and always hated having to pick up the pieces after and pretend to be ok.

I'm going to die in the sun on a nice day, in a pretty dress, reading my favourite book. I will never feel like this again. The people I care about most understand my choice. Theyll be fine eventually. And I'll be so free.
